* Experience developing BCM strategies, governance frameworks, policies, standards, and roadmaps.
* Experience leading BCM exercises, recovery testing, crisis simulations, and response activities.
* Strong understanding of Emergency Response, Crisis Management, and Operational Resilience principles.

* Strong project management, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead programs, manage timelines, and deliver results in a consulting environment.

title: Project Specialist
description:

This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
Construction Management
  
  

* Support on-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Development of the work methodology and detailed day-to-day execution plan for the refurbishment of HVDC components (Valves and Control Systems) in alignment with the approved outage schedule.
* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non-conformances, and site technical queries.

Commissioning Management
  
  

* Development of pre-commissioning and commissioning documentation, checklists, and reporting formats.
* Plan and manage pre-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.

Environment, Health, & Safety (EHS) and Quality
  
  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.

Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
  
  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.

Documentation and Compliance
  
  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.
* Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams in a remote/distributed capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.
* Strong data analysis skills for reporting project performance, risks, and recovery plans.

Typical Experience Profile
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 8+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization

Working Conditions
  
  

* Office-based role with significant domestic travel requirements.
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high-pressure commissioning periods.
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary. Depending on project requirements, site assignments may involve extended on-site deployments for prolonged durations.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics and Procurement Systems, this role will manage the intake, analysis, coordination, and delivery of system and process enhancements that improve procurement execution, visibility, compliance, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
The Senior Systems Analyst will serve as a connector between Procurement Operations, Category Managers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Technology, and business stakeholders. Selon votre poste et votre lieu de travail, vous pourriez être admissible à des primes et incitatifs annuels, à des avantages liés à la santé et au bien-être, à des congés rémunérés, à des régimes de retraite, à une couverture d’assurance ainsi qu’à d’autres avantages locaux ou prévus par la loi.
  
  
Les détails précis de la rémunération et des avantages associés à ce poste seront discutés au cours du processus de recrutement.

title: Senior Trust & Assurance Program Manager- Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the worldâ€™s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBMâ€™s product and technology landscape. Here, youâ€™ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of Confluent’s Trust and Security organization and its mission is to earn and retain trust by championing Confluent’s security, privacy, resilience, and compliance positions, thereby accelerating customer adoption and use of our platform and products.
  
  
We are looking for an individual who will partner with Confluent's customers to ensure that we build the most trustworthy platform that meets security, compliance, and privacy requirements.
  
  
Success in this role will be finding the best solution not only with the current technologies and practices we currently have on hand, but defining new opportunities for product development, customer engagement strategy, audit and access transparency, and field enablement.
  
  
While this role will engage with leadership frequently, we also expect the individual in this role to roll up their sleeves to get things done. The OCISO Trust Lead will “lead by influence”, and oversee and drive trust (security, privacy, resilience and compliance) related customer engagements and interactions.
  
  
The APAC OCISO Trust Lead will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Solutions Group, Product, Engineering and Legal teams to provide assurance to customers on Confluent’s security and compliance posture, enable contract reviews and negotiations, and drive externally facing communications with customers
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of customer trust engagements and interactions to provide context about Confluent's security and compliance posture and negotiate security terms when necessary
* Propose and partner with product, engineering, and security teams to design security and compliance solutions and frameworks to meet customer requirements
* Coach and mentor field and security staff on customer security needs and requirements
* Be a subject matter expert for the company around customer security assurance, and develop and demonstrate POVs on important existing and emerging regulatory positions impacting cloud service adoption
* Build and scale key internal capabilities and programs required to drive customer enablement interactions
* Maintain relations with internal teams such as Sales, CSG, Product, Engineering and Legal to drive and enable programs required to build trust with customers

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required plus a minimum of 8 years’ experience in Information Security and Compliance
* Customer-facing experience at a cloud provider or consulting firm
* Experience at a cloud or SaaS provider or as a customer of a cloud or SaaS provider with complex & demanding security and compliance requirements
* Experience with a combination of the following: ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOC2, CSA, NIST, etc.
* Architectural familiarity across multiple security domains (e.g., identity and access management, data protection, network security, cloud infrastructure) with the ability to synthesize across domains and recommend practical solutions to complex customer security problems
* Proven experience independently managing customer trust and assurance engagements end-to-end — from initial scoping and security questionnaires through assessment completion and negotiation — with minimal supervision.
* Understanding of digital sovereignty requirements relevant to Cloud adoption

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
Additional highly desirable experience:
  
  

* Current Security CISSP, CIPP, CISA, CISM, or equivalent certification completed
* Excellent verbal and written communication, organizational, and planning skills
* Knowledge and understanding of GDPR, SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST, CSA, NIST, C5, and other regulatory security and privacy standards in APAC (such as OSPAR, IRAP)
* Experience with industry (Financial Services, Public Sector, etc.) specific regulatory requirements impacting cloud adoption such as GDPR, and other APAC security, privacy and compliance standards and regulations (e.g. from Financial Services regulators such as APRA, MAS, RBI, FSA, OJK, HKMA, etc.)
* Prior experience reviewing and negotiating security clauses within customer contracts a plus
* Demonstrated ability to assess the broader risk implications of customer security engagements, and to proactively structure work in a way that reduces risk exposure for both the customer and Confluent.
* Familiarity with emerging AI/ML security and governance considerations, including data pipeline security, model risk, and evolving regulatory expectations around AI in cloud environments.
* Ability to work and lead programs independently

title: Commissiong Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
Construction Management
  
  

* Support on-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non-conformances, and site technical queries.

Commissioning Management
  
  

* Plan and manage pre-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.

Environment, Health, & Safety (EHS) and Quality
  
  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.

Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
  
  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.

Documentation and Compliance
  
  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.

Typical Experience Profile
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 5+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization

Working Conditions
  
  

* Site based role
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high-pressure commissioning periods
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

* Finding creative professionals like photographers, cinematographers, video editors, designers, social media specialists, production heads, and other creative professionals.
* Build structured screening and shortlisting systems.
* Create role-specific assessments and assignments.
* Conduct initial interviews and coordinate technical evaluations.
* Maintain a strong pipeline of future candidates.
* Build and manage a dependable freelancer and vendor network.
* Improve hiring turnaround time without compromising quality.
* Create a database of full-time candidates, freelancers, specialists, and emerging talent.

In short - When the agency needs talent, we should already know where to find it.

**> Team Management & Accountability -**
You will be responsible for helping build a high-performance culture within the organisation. This includes:

* Employee onboarding
* Role clarity
* Performance reviews
* Employee productivity
* Goal setting
* Accountability systems
* Identifying underperformance
* Team coordination
* Employee retention
* Career progression
* Performance-linked incentives
* Handling people-related issues and escalations

You must be comfortable having difficult conversations when required and holding people accountable for commitments.

**> Agency Operations -**
You will gradually take ownership of the day-to-day operations of Marketing Studio. Responsibilities include:

* Project planning
* Resource allocation
* Capacity planning
* Project ownership
* Internal project tracking
* Production scheduling
* Shoot scheduling
* Post-production scheduling
* Freelancer allocation
* Vendor coordination
* Deadline management
* Team coordination
* Escalation management
* Quality-control processes
* Workload balancing

You should always know - What projects are active, who owns them, what is due next, where the bottlenecks are, and whether delivery is on track.

**> Projects Delivery -**
Once a project is closed by the sales team, you will be responsible for ensuring that it moves smoothly from onboarding to final delivery. This includes:

* Understanding project requirements
* Conducting structured handovers from sales
* Defining deliverables and timelines
* Assigning responsibilities
* Monitoring project progress
* Identifying delays early
* Managing internal dependencies
* Coordinating revisions
* Ensuring final delivery meets agreed expectations

Your goal will be to create a system where projects do not depend on anyone except you following up with every team member.

**> Client Coordination & Relationship Management -**
You will work closely with clients during project execution. Responsibilities include:

* Managing operational communication after project onboarding
* Setting clear expectations
* Sharing project updates
* Managing approvals and feedback
* Handling revision cycles
* Managing delays professionally
* Resolving operational escalations
* Maintaining strong client relationships
* Protecting both client satisfaction and company interests

You should be confident communicating with senior clients and handling difficult situations calmly and professionally.

**> Systems, SOPs & Process Building -**
A major part of this role is converting an entrepreneur-led operation into a system-led organisation. You will be expected to create and continuously improve:

* Recruitment funnels
* Candidate databases
* Freelancer databases
* Employee onboarding processes
* Project trackers
* Production calendars
* Resource planning systems
* Performance dashboards
* SOPs
* Client handover processes
* Approval workflows
* Escalation processes
* Employee review systems
* Vendor management systems
* Reporting structures

We are looking for someone who can not only work within systems, but also build and improve them.

**> Workforce & Capacity Planning -**
You should be able to help management answer questions such as:

* How much additional business can the current team handle?
* Which team or department is overloaded?
* Should we hire someone full-time or use a freelancer?
* Where are project delays originating?
* Which team members are high performers?
* Which functions require stronger systems?
* What manpower will be required to support the next stage of growth?

**What we are looking for?**

You may be a strong fit if:

* You have 5+ years of professional experience in Agency Operations, Business Operations, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Project Management, or related functions.
* You have managed both people and projects.
* You have personally handled recruitment.
* You understand how to identify good candidates beyond their CV.
* You are comfortable recruiting difficult-to-find creative professionals.
* You have experience managing teams and holding people accountable.
* You understand deadline-driven service businesses.
* You are highly organised and process-oriented.
* You are confident communicating with clients and senior management.
* You can manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* You are proactive and capable of solving problems independently.
* You think in terms of ownership, systems, efficiency, and outcomes.
* You are comfortable working directly with the Founder.

title: Program Manager-PL
description:
**Job title:**
Program Manager
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Managing Director
  
  
**Location**
: Noida/Kolkata (Open for all India travel)
  
  
**About Axiom Consulting**
Since 2002, we have witnessed the transformation of the Indian economy, led by multi-generational
  
  
Indian business families who have successfully evolved their family-run businesses into mid-to-large
  
  
corporations. Participating in this economic transformation from the boardrooms of some of India's
  
  
most prominent business houses has given us deep confidence in the economic and growth potential of
  
  
our diverse country.
  
  
Over the last three decades, we have developed deep domain expertise across Manufacturing, Retail,
  
  
Distribution and Service industries, integrating and automating business processes on global ERP, CRM
  
  
and HR platforms. In addition, we have built our own distribution management, point-of-sale, vendor
  
  
and customer portal solutions to close process gaps around global platforms for our clients.
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization focused on helping clients
  
  
move from fragmented processes and systems to integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven
  
  
operations.
  
  
**Our approach to ERP implementation rests on two key tracks:**

* Industry Best Practices & ERP Transformation We evaluate a client's existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and enable these through leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not simply to implement software, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models that reflect proven industry practice.
* Sustained Organizational Change ERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management. We work with clients to embed new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day habits of their workforce - ensuring the solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only a technology deployment.

**OUR CLIENT SEGMENT**
**The Role Will Support Clients Across Three Broad Segments**
▪ Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.
  
  
▪ Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.
  
  
▪ Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the
  
  
₹200–800 crore range.
  
  
**OUR FOCUS AREAS**
We maintain a strong focus on Compliance and Corporate Governance, supported by a Centre of
  
  
Excellence comprising experienced functional and domain professionals.
  
  
Our clients typically come from non-ERP or fragmented-system environments, where business
  
  
processes are managed through standalone applications or disconnected modular systems across
  
  
departments. This calls for an articulate leader who can effectively drive high-level conversations across
  
  
diverse steering committees and technical groups — managing governance, schedule and scope with an
  
  
80% onsite/onshore presence.
  
  
**Role, Scope & Responsibilities**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead large-scale
  
  
enterprise transformation programs. The ideal candidate will bring a stable career history (a maximum
  
  
of 1–2 employers) and a proven track record of driving complex software, ERP and CRM
  
  
implementations.
  
  
As our projects and client relationships typically span 10–15 years, the most important hiring mandate is
  
  
stability: candidates should have at least 8–10 years of single, continuous tenure with a Top Tier
  
  
company.
  
  
▪ Drive Executive Conversations: Lead, influence and drive strategic conversations with C-suite
  
  
executives, business heads and partners to secure buy-in and align expectations.
  
  
▪ Lead Enterprise Transformations: Direct complex implementations across Software/ERP platforms
  
  
(Microsoft, SAP), including surround technologies and other custom solutions.
  
  
▪ Facilitate Governance & Alignment: Own the project schedule, scope and governance framework chairing steering committee meetings and cross-functional workshops.
  
  
▪ Manage RAID & Risks: Proactively identify, articulate and mitigate program risks, assumptions,
  
  
issues and dependencies (RAID) during stakeholder reviews.
  
  
▪ Onshore Leadership: Operate effectively in an onsite/onshore model (80% presence), driving daily
  
  
face-to-face collaboration with client teams.
  
  
**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
▪ Experience: 10+ years of core project and program management experience.
  
  
▪ Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills, with the ability to drive complex
  
  
conversations between business users and technical teams.
  
  
▪ Professional Stability: A stable, progressive career track record — preferably 1–3 organisations, with
  
  
at least 80% of total tenure spent at a single organisation.
  
  
▪ Target Background: Proven delivery experience within tier-1 tech integrators and consulting firms,
  
  
such as IBM, Wipro, TCS, CTS, Infosys, HCL, Capgemini, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, etc.
  
  
▪ Methodologies: Expert knowledge of program governance, budgeting and structured deployment
  
  
frameworks.
  
  
**Out Of Scope — What This Role Is Not**
Candidates whose primary experience lies in the following areas will not be considered:
  
  
▪ Service delivery management or support-operations projects.
  
  
▪ Ticket management, SLA tracking, or ITSM frameworks.
  
  
▪ Pure resourcing / team management.
  
  
▪ Core infrastructure, networking, or technical migration projects (DWH / Cloud / Infra).
  
  
▪ Candidates not comfortable with the travel required for client engagements.
  
  
Skills: budgeting,program governance,program,structured deployment frameworks,projects

* A degree in civil engineering /Mechanical Engineering
* Experience in engineering design, in roles of increasing responsibility and project complexity.

* Proactive approach, and able to adapt to changing scenarios
* Proven client liaison skills
* Experience of working on complex multidisciplinary projects
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* A strong technical focus, able to innovate and lead by example
* Excellent knowledge of current international codes and regulations

title: Associate - Electrical (Metro)
description:
**Job Description**
This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -
  
  

* Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others.
* Agree the project deliverables and programme.
* Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost.
* Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.
* Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues.
* Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards.
* Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc.
* Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed.
* Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L.
* Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy.
* Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted.
* Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
* The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence.
* The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage.
* The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite.
* The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working.
* Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.
* Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution.

**Establishment and growth of GCC**

* Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
* Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
* Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
* Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity.
* Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
* Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe.
* Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below.
* Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

**Technical and Project Management**

* Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
* Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
* Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
* Promote technical excellence in all our projects
* Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
* Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

**Commercial**

* Implement the project delivery systems and structures
* Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
* Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
* Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

**Qualifications**

* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services.
* Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux.
* A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential.
* Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
* A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential.
* Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.

title: Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
The
**Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System**
serves as the strategic and operational bridge between the Pharmacovigilance (PV) business/operations teams and the technical organization. This individual acts as the
**system champion, business representative, and end-to-end accountability owner**
for one or more pharmacovigilance platforms and integrated solutions — ensuring these systems meet regulatory, operational, and quality standards throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a unique blend of deep PV domain expertise, systems thinking, stakeholder management, and a forward-looking understanding of emerging technologies including AI. This person ensures those technical workstreams are effectively directed and aligned to business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Ownership and Governance
  
  

* Serve as the accountable business system owner for PV-related platforms, including safety databases, signal management tools, medical information systems, literature monitoring solutions, and reporting platforms
* Own and maintain the system roadmap, prioritizing enhancements, upgrades, and new feature rollouts in alignment with business strategy and regulatory requirements
* Lead and manage system lifecycle activities — from business requirements definition, UAT, deployment, through to retirement — ensuring timely and quality delivery of all system milestones
* Maintain and govern all business-owned system documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, SOPs, user guides, and validation plans (in close collaboration with validation/QA teams)
* Drive business sign-off and acceptance for all system changes, releases, and validation activities

Business–IT Liaison and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary point of contact for all system-related matters between PV Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and the Technical/IT organization
* Translate complex business and regulatory needs into clear, actionable technical requirements for IT developers and vendors
* Facilitate regular forums, governance meetings, and working groups to ensure alignment across business and technical stakeholders
* Manage relationships with external system vendors and platform providers, including participating in vendor performance reviews, roadmap discussions, and contract input where applicable
* Escalate risks, issues, and decisions through appropriate channels with clear business impact framing

System Champion and Change Enablement
  
  

* Serve as the internal ambassador for PV systems — promoting best practices, driving adoption, and advocating for user-centric design
* Lead change management efforts for system rollouts and upgrades, including communication planning, training coordination, and stakeholder engagement
* Represent the PV systems landscape in cross-functional forums, steering committees, and process improvement initiatives
* Champion the adoption of innovative technologies — including AI/ML-assisted capabilities — within the PV ecosystem, evaluating feasibility and business value in partnership with IT

Compliance, Quality & Regulatory Alignment
  
  

* Ensure all systems under ownership comply with applicable global regulatory frameworks, including ICH E2B(R3), EMA EVMPD, FDA requirements, and GVP modules
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure systems are maintained in a validated state in accordance with GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11
* Support and participate in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections related to PV systems
* Monitor the regulatory landscape and proactively identify impacts to systems from evolving guidance, communicating these to relevant stakeholders
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and audit trail standards are upheld across all system interactions

Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define, track, and report on system KPIs and performance metrics, driving continuous improvement initiatives based on operational data
* Identify and implement process optimizations at the intersection of business workflows and system capabilities
* Support business continuity planning related to system downtime, data recovery, and disaster recovery scenarios
* Contribute to strategic planning for the PV systems portfolio, including build/buy/partner evaluations and technology investment recommendations

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Health Informatics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* 3–5 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or a closely related discipline
* Demonstrated experience owning or managing PV systems or technology platforms in a business capacity
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end life science lifecycle, from case intake through aggregate reporting and signal management
* Experience working in a regulated GxP environment and with validated systems

Key Skills and Competencies
  
  
Business and Stakeholder Skills
  
  

* Exceptional cross-functional communication — able to speak both "business" and "technology" fluently
* Strong project and program management skills; ability to manage multiple system workstreams simultaneously
* Proven ability to influence without authority across organizational levels and functions
* High-level analytical and critical thinking — able to assess complex problems and drive solutions
* Skilled in requirements gathering, business process mapping, and gap analysis
* Effective vendor management and negotiation capabilities
* Comfortable presenting to and engaging senior leadership

Personal Competencies
  
  

* Detail-oriented with a quality-first mindset
* Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable operating with ambiguity and autonomy
* Collaborative and empathetic — a natural team enabler and culture carrier
* Adaptable to a rapidly evolving technology and regulatory landscape
* Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in a patient safety context

Technical Knowledge Requirements
  
  
PV Safety Databases & Case Management
  
  

* Hands-on familiarity (business user level) with leading safety databases.
* Understanding of E2B(R3) case data structure, ICSR processing workflows, MedDRA coding, and regulatory submission timelines (e.g., 7/15-day reporting)

Reporting & Analytics Tools
  
  

* Experience with PV reporting platforms and dashboards, Power BI or equivalent BI tools for operational metrics CIOMS and PSUR/PBRER report generation workflows
* Ability to define and validate KPI reporting requirements in collaboration with data teams

Signal Detection & Management Tools
  
  

* Familiarity with signal management platforms.
* Understanding of disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM) and signal workflow from detection through evaluation and escalation
* Knowledge of EudraVigilance and FDA FAERS database structures and access

Literature Monitoring & Search Tools
  
  

* Experience with or oversight of systematic literature search tools.
* Understanding of ICSR extraction from literature, deduplication, and integration with safety databases.
* Awareness of AI-powered literature monitoring solutions and automation capabilities in this space

Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies
  
  

* Awareness of AI/ML applications in pharmacovigilance, including: AI-assisted case narrative generation and MedDRA auto-coding NLP for literature monitoring and social media surveillance Predictive analytics for signal detection and risk assessment Large Language Models (LLMs) and their responsible use in PV workflows
* Ability to critically evaluate AI vendor claims and assess technology fit for regulated PV environments
* Understanding of AI governance requirements in GxP contexts (data lineage, explainability, auditability)

Data and Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Understanding of PV data flows and system integrations (e.g., CRO feeds, affiliate submissions, E2B gateway connections)
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, E2B XML data standards
* Comfort with data mapping, data quality principles, and working alongside data architects and engineers
* Basic understanding of API-based integrations and middleware concepts (not hands-on, but enough to direct and review)

Regulatory & Quality Frameworks
  
  

* Solid knowledge of GVP Modules (especially I, V, VI, VIII, IX, XVI)
* Working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and CSV/CSA (Computer Software Assurance) principles
* Familiarity with ICH E2A, E2B, E2C, E2D, E2E guidelines
* Understanding of audit trail requirements, data integrity standards (ALCOA+), and inspection readiness

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, nursing, public health, epidemiology, regulatory affairs, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, epidemiology, risk management, scientific consulting, regulatory affairs, or a related field required. Certification in pharmacovigilance, drug safety preferred. Certification in regulatory affairs, clinical safety preferred. Certification in quality management, auditing preferred.

title: INGENIEUR ARRANGEMENT PIPING CIVIL PROJET
description:

L’Ingénieur Arrangement – Piping – Civil Projet est responsable de la coordination globale des disciplines Installation Générale (Arrangement), Tuyauterie/Robinetterie et Génie Civil/Charpente.
  
  
Il agit comme point focal technique transverse entre les Lead Engineers métiers et les fonctions projet, en interface directe avec le Project Engineering Manager (PEM). Il assure la cohérence technique, le respect des délais, des coûts et de la qualité, et anime le daily management et le pilotage de la performance des disciplines.
  
  
**Ce role s'inscrit dans la management de projets nucléaires UK program (HPC, Sizewell)**

* Coordination technique transverse
* Piloter et coordonner les activités des Lead Engineers Arrangement, Piping et Civil sur le périmètre salle des machines.
* Garantir la cohérence globale du design (implantation, interfaces équipements/structures/tuyauteries).
* Assurer la bonne intégration des contraintes : sûreté nucléaire, constructibilité, accessibilité & maintenabilité, exigences contractuelles et réglementaires.
* Anticiper et arbitrer les interfaces techniques complexes entre disciplines.
* S’assurer du respect des normes, codes et standards applicables (EN, ASME, Eurocodes, PED…).
* Animation du Daily Management
* Mettre en place et animer le daily/weekly management des disciplines (rituels de pilotage).
* Suivre l’avancement des livrables clés et identifier les points de blocage.
* Prioriser les actions court terme en lien avec le planning projet.
* Faciliter la résolution rapide des problèmes techniques et organisationnels.
* Créer une dynamique de travail transverse orientée performance collective.
* Pilotage Planning, Coûts et KPI
* Consolider les entrées des Lead Engineers pour le Engineering Master Time Schedule (MTS).
* Suivre la tenue des jalons : Design Reviews, Design Freeze, émissions critiques.
* Mettre en place et animer des KPI projet, notamment : Avancement physique (EDM), Respect des délais de livraison, Charge homme/heure vs budget, Nombre et cycle de traitement des NCR / FSI / DCR, Stabilité du design (design changes).
* Identifier les dérives planning/coûts et proposer des plans de mitigation au PEM.
* Reporting et interface projet
* Assurer un reporting consolidé clair et synthétique vers le PEM : avancement, risques & opportunités, points critiques multi‑disciplines.
* Préparer les éléments nécessaires aux revues de design et gateways projet.
* Être le relais privilégié du PEM pour les sujets techniques transverses.
* Contribuer à la gestion des variations, claims et évolutions de scope.
* Qualité, sûreté et retour d’expérience
* Veiller à l’application stricte des processus qualité, sûreté nucléaire et EHS.
* S’assurer du traitement rapide et efficace des NCR, FSI, DCR.
* Garantir l’application des processus de Design Freeze et Change Management.
* Capitaliser le retour d’expérience et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques.
* Autorité et responsabilités
* Autorité fonctionnelle sur les Lead Engineers Arrangement, Piping et Civil pour le pilotage projet.
* Capacité à arbitrer les priorités techniques et organisationnelles dans le respect du cadre projet.
* Propose au PEM les décisions structurantes impactant planning, coûts ou design.

**Formation & expérience**

* Diplôme d’ingénieur (mécanique, génie civil ou équivalent).
* 10 ans minimum d’expérience en ingénierie de centrales (nucléaire ou grands projets industriels).
* Expérience confirmée en coordination multi‑disciplines et en environnement projet complexe.
* Bonne culture des disciplines :

+ Installation Générale / Layout,
+ Tuyauterie & Robinetterie,
+ Génie Civil & structures métalliques.

**Compétences techniques**

* Solide compréhension des interfaces techniques.
* Connaissance des processus d’ingénierie nucléaire et de gestion du design.
* Capacité à analyser rapidement les impacts planning, coûts et risques.

**Compétences comportementales**

* Leadership transverse et posture de chef d’orchestre.
* Excellentes capacités de communication et de synthèse.
* Orientation résultats, structuration et rigueur.
* Capacité à gérer les priorités et la pression projet.
* Forte culture sécurité et sûreté nucléaire.

**Langues**

* Anglais courant
* Français courant

title: Research And Development Manager(Food technologist)
description:
**Company Description**
Foodsure is a specialized food innovation and commercialization partner focused on bridging the gap between product formulation and commercial scale. The team works at the intersection of food science, product development, manufacturing, and brand strategy to help founders turn ideas into viable, launch-ready products. With experience across 1000+ formulations, Foodsure supports categories such as functional beverages, protein foods, nutraceuticals, snacks, sauces, premixes, and emerging food segments. Its end-to-end approach spans market feasibility, R&D, sensory validation, pilot trials, regulatory readiness, manufacturing, and commercial launch. Foodsure is driven by a forward-looking vision to help build the next major food and beverage categories before markets become saturated.
  
**Role Description**
The Research and Development Manager (Food Technologist) will lead end-to-end product development projects, from concept through commercialization, ensuring products are technically sound, scalable, and aligned with market needs. This full-time on-site role, based in Noida, involves designing and optimizing formulations, overseeing lab and pilot trials, and collaborating with manufacturing partners to ensure smooth scale-up. The role includes managing sensory evaluations, ensuring compliance with relevant food safety and regulatory standards, and maintaining documentation of formulations, processes, and test results. The manager will guide and mentor R&D team members, coordinate project timelines and resources, and work closely with founders, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business objectives into innovative, commercially viable food and beverage solutions.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Research and Development (R&D) and Research skills, with experience in food technology or food science.
* Demonstrated Team Management and Team Leadership capabilities to guide, mentor, and develop R&D staff.
* Proven Project Management skills, including planning, prioritizing, and delivering multiple R&D projects on time.
* In-depth knowledge of food formulation, ingredient functionality, sensory evaluation, and scale-up from lab to manufacturing.
* Familiarity with food safety standards, regulatory requirements, and quality assurance practices in the food and beverage industry.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, communicate technical concepts clearly, and work effectively with founders and clients.
* Experience with functional foods, nutraceuticals, or emerging food categories is an advantage.

description:

title: Senior BMS Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Join us in Making Future
  
  
At AFRY, we engineer change for our clients using our deep sector knowledge within the fields of infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalisation. When we collaborate on challenging and meaningful assignments, we succeed together with a collective of skilled and friendly colleagues. We do this with a higher purpose, to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society for generations to come.
  
  
Join us in Making Future.
  
  
**About AFRY**
We are 18,000 colleagues present in 40 countries globally, and we intend to grow even further to increase our positive impact on society.
  
  
At AFRY we have a strong focus on diversity and inclusion. We are brave, devoted team players, collaborating across the world to accelerate the sustainable transition. If you are looking for a workplace where you will develop and at the same time contribute to something meaningful, you have found the right place.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Building Management Systems (BMS) Engineer**
to join our international team of experts and help create smarter, safer, and more sustainable buildings worldwide.
  
  
As part of a global consultancy, you will work alongside specialists in mechanical, electrical, fire safety, sustainability, and digital engineering to deliver state-of-the-art solutions for some of the most exciting projects in the market.
  
  
Our projects span data centers, hospitals, pharmaceutical facilities, commercial developments, airports, industrial plants, public buildings, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
As a BMS Engineer, you will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from early-stage advisory and concept design to detailed engineering, commissioning, optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Design and specification of Building Management Systems (BMS) or Building Automation and Control Systems (BACS)
* Development of smart building and automation strategies
* Control and integration of HVAC, lighting, energy monitoring, security, fire alarm and other building systems
* Preparation of technical specifications, control descriptions, and engineering documentation
* Development and review of network architectures and communication protocols
* Participation in commissioning, testing and system validation
* Energy optimization and operational performance analysis
* Client advisory services and technical leadership in multidisciplinary projects
* Supporting digital twin and smart building initiatives

We are looking for an ambitious engineer who combines technical expertise with a strong customer focus and a passion for innovation.
  
  
Deep specialist expertise in building automation with a developed overall understanding of how the building's technical installations and systems interact. Create optimal functional relationships and integrations between HVAC, Electrical and control systems and have a central role in installation coordination, to ensure that technical system solutions and construction support both the business's needs, energy efficiency and long-term operation in Nordic conditions.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in BMS, building automation, industrial automation or smart building systems
* Experience with platforms such as Siemens Desigo, Schneider EcoStruxure, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, Trend, Saia Burgess Controls, Delta Controls, Beckhoff or similar
* Understanding of communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, Dali, KNX, LoRaWorks, LonWorks, and MQTT
* Experience with BIM and digital project environments is considered an advantage
* Knowledge of sustainable and energy-efficient building technologies
* Good communication skills in English
* Experience from Nordic projects and conditions

**Preferred Experience**

* Data Centers
* Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities
* Laboratories and Pharmaceutical Facilities
* Commercial Real Estate
* Industrial Facilities
* Mission Critical Environments

**Personal Attributes**
We believe you are:
  
  

* Solution-oriented and innovative
* Client-focused and commercially aware
* Passionate about technology and digital transformation
* Comfortable working in international project teams
* A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts clearly
* Curious and committed to continuous learning

**Additional Information**
*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*

description:

title: Package Manager - Casting
description:
The Package Manager is responsible for the overall management and delivery performance of supplier-provided goods and services within a project environment.
  
  
He/She ensures that supplier commitments are met in terms of schedule adherence, cost performance, and documentation compliance, while working closely with Project Management, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
  
  
The position reports directly to the Commodity Sourcing Team Leader.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
Supplier Delivery Management
  
  

* Assume overall responsibility for order fulfilment activities for the assigned project scope.
* Define the expediting strategy no later than the Notice to Proceed (NTP), in coordination with the Project Procurement Leader (PPLM) and the Project Quality Manager (PQM).
* Ensure alignment of the expediting strategy with the project schedule, Engineering Procurement Plan (EPP), Master Time Schedule, and allocated budget.

Coordination and Performance Management
  
  

* Coordinate and leverage expediting activities together with Supplier Quality (SQ) teams to maximize synergies across projects, suppliers, and sites.
* Lead regular reviews of critical procurement packages with the PPLM.
* Closely monitor expediting-related costs and ensure compliance with the Order Fulfilment budget.
* Provide early warnings in the event of schedule slippage or delivery risks.

Operational Follow-up and Reporting
  
  

* Confirm completion of deliverables and receipt of equipment within project tracking systems (PMX) to ensure accurate On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance reporting.
* Contribute to budgeting and forecasting activities related to Order Fulfilment.
* Prepare and issue periodic consolidated reports (e.g., through digital tools such as SUMO), including delivery status, risks, and opportunities.
* Ensure compliance with Group processes, tools, standards, and methodologies related to Order Fulfilment activities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
**The Supplier Performance Manager Is Assessed, Among Others, On**

* Complete and on-time delivery of project equipment and procurement packages.
* Compliance with allocated budgets.
* Effectiveness of mitigation and recovery plans.
* Quality, accuracy, and timeliness of reporting.
* Adherence to global processes and quality of data maintained in company systems.

Autonomy and Authority
  
  

* Ability to make decisions and provide direction within the assigned area of responsibility, in alignment with project stakeholders.

**Required Competencies**

* Basic knowledge of Quality Management, commercial considerations, planning, scheduling, and industrial operations.
* Experience in supplier management and delivery performance monitoring.
* Proficiency with business systems, databases, and digital tools.

**Profile And Qualifications**
Education and Experience
  
  

* Minimum Bachelor's degree (Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or equivalent).
* Significant experience in Procurement and/or Project Management, ideally supporting complex, high-value projects.
* Strong contract management knowledge and experience.

Key Skills
  
  

* Leadership and strong team-oriented mindset.
* Proactive approach with strong anticipation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and resource management skills.
* Ability to prepare professional reports, procedures, and business communications.
* Strong communication skills with internal stakeholders, customers, and third parties.

Languages
  
  

* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

**Additional Requirements**

* Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in one or more of the following industries: Power Generation, Heavy Industry, Nuclear, Aerospace.
* Basic knowledge of project management principles.
* Awareness of financial, legal, and risk management considerations.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and adapt quickly within a project-driven environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS
  
  

* Availability for frequent business travel.

title: Team Lead C++, Software Development
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
  
  
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers.
  
  
We are looking for a team lead with experience working across servers and clients with knowledge of Ruby On Rails, C++, JavaScript and more. You will lead the work to bring capabilities from our Observability platform into our DEX platform. This will involve making technical decisions about the best way we can integrate to provide our users with the best customer experience whilst ensuring that we can converge our 2 platforms into a single unified, scalable, maintainable platform.
  
  
Our observability platform consists of an agent (C++, QT, Electron, JavaScript), a UI (React, Vue, Angular) and a backend (Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2). Our DEX platform consists of an agent (C++), a UI (React) and a backend (C# .Net Core 8 running on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EventHub, Kafka, Databricks).
  
  
You will own the delivery of the roadmap, working closely with our existing observability team that is US-based to deliver the integration whilst also supporting the maintenance of the existing platform.
  
  

* Own delivery roadmap and technical direction for integrating the acquired product into our platform and delivery of new features.
* Drive architectural decisions that meet product requirements whilst considering key non-functional requirements such as scalability, security and maintainability – taking an approach that aligns with our north star of converging to a single unified platform.
* Align stakeholders (Product, Security, Operations) and manage risks, dependencies and scope.
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards: CI/CD quality gates, secure SDLC, and observability/SLOs.
* Coach and develop the team; enable predictable delivery and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
* 12+ years of software development experience with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team.
* Experienced in leading delivery of cloud-based solution that has required collaboration across different teams.
* Experience with Azure/AWS cloud services such as: Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis, event streaming
* Experience leading project delivery in collaboration with remote teams
* Experience working with C++, JavaScript and QT
* Experience applying engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations.
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top-10 vulnerabilities & remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
* Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
* A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
* A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
* Fluency in English is mandatory.
* Experience working with network protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, SSL/TLS, UDP, SIP, RTP is a plus.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role description:**
Our Arcadis – GEC (India) team is seeking a Principal Wastewater Modeller. In this position, you will lead the development of wastewater models, manage key project aspects, and work closely with the UK modelling team and the clients to build and expand Arcadis’s project portfolio through strategic client interactions. You will form the core of an expanding modelling team in GEC-India. Collaboration, proactive problem-solving, and creative thinking are central to our team’s approach, and will be a fundamental part of your role.
  
  
Our team is at the forefront of tackling some of the UK’s most technically demanding projects and AMP8 programmes. Renowned for our expertise, we work in close partnership with leading water companies and contractors to deliver innovative solutions. Our projects focus on addressing flooding challenges, reducing storm overflow pollution, and improving network resilience, all while ensuring compliance with UK regulatory requirements, and adhering to industry best practices.
  
  
This position is perfect for a motivated and independent professional looking to further their career while mentoring and nurturing the development of others. The role involves taking a leadership position in team building and technical support, client engagement and management, particularly with water utilities, ensuring technical deliverables align with client expectations and fostering opportunities for continued collaboration and growth.
  
  
**Role accountabilities:**

* Deliver a range of wastewater infrastructure and non-infrastructure modelling projects, effectively managing tasks of various scales.
* Conduct technical reviews of wastewater models, oversee model build and verification of sewer networks, oversee survey planning and management, develop strategic solutions as per clients’ requirements
* Provide support to designers at concept outline and detailed design stages
* Review and enhance technical reports and presentations to uphold high-quality standards.
* Resolve technical modelling challenges on projects and contribute to advancing the team's technical expertise
* Ensure project components, including reports, drawings, specifications, and studies, comply with relevant standards and project requirements
* Collaborate closely with clients, providing clear explanations and ensuring they understand model outputs and processes.
* Support and guide junior team members, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Assist with preparation of bids including narratives, cost estimates and programmes.
* Coordinate project elements, managing resource allocation, quality assurance, subcontractor interactions, and client feedback.
* Work alongside specialists from other engineering and environmental disciplines to ensure project integrity.
* Liaise effectively with the Project Director or Manager and the client to support project progress.
* Foster a collaborative work environment by actively supporting the professional development of both yourself and your team, guiding junior members to reach their full potential.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Have 11-14 years of experience Masters in Water Resources Management/Environment/Civil Engineering or Equivalent
* Advanced expertise in hydraulic modelling for a range of wastewater infrastructure and non-infrastructure projects
* Skilled in team and stakeholder coordination and management
* Proficient in InfoWorks ICM
* HADES knowledge would be advantageous
* Competent in using relevant GIS software packages
* Chartered member of a relevant professional institution (e.g., ICE or CIWEM)
* Proven experience in model quality assurance procedures
* Strong report-writing skills
* Advanced abilities in spreadsheet-based data analysis
* Coding/Automation experience desirable

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
  
  
#Join Arcadis. #Create a Legacy. #Hybrid

title: Sr. Project Officer - MELS & Digital Transformation
description:
**Description**
Senior Project Officer: MELS & Digital Transformation
  
  
**Background**
Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provides services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. This position may also require service agreements, secondment agreements, between entities, etc.
  
  
PGPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identify, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
  
  
**Function**
This position will support the development and manage the implementation of monitoring, evaluation, learning and systems (MELS) and Digital Transformation of the organization. A strong emphasis for this role is on IT enabled system, digital innovation, data collection, ensuring data quality, partner capacity building on MELS, evaluation/survey management, integrity, data analysis, reporting, dissemination, and learnings.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)
  
  
MELS: Implement monitoring, evaluation, learning, and systems for the project. (35%)
  
  

* Lead the implementation of the MELS Plan for the project.
* Review and adjust MELS plans and targets, tools, and processes periodically and update the same.
* Coordinate for annual outcome monitoring/surveys.
* Work with external evaluators to conduct the Baseline, Mid-term and final evaluations while ensuring data quality.
* Conduct and manage the monitoring of project progress, living income validation, and output monitoring as per the MELS plan.
* Ensure the effective implementation of PGPL MELS policies and procedures for the project.
* Disseminate learning findings from project monitoring, evaluation, and research. Lead learning events with key stakeholders within the project communities, implementation partners, and PGPL in general.
* Elevate MELS-related challenges to the Project Director and Associate Director – MELS for coordination with the Executive Country Director to find timely solutions;
* Design data collection tools, plans, and processes for all required information, ensuring high quality and integrity of data.
* Support the development of project frameworks and logical frameworks for all new projects.
* Support in the rollout and manage the PGPL MELS system and IPMS for the projects.

Digital Transformation: Enabling IT, Innovations & IT Support (30%)
  
  

* Lead the integration of the organization's PMIS system with digital dashboards for real-time data visualization and decision-making.
* Develop and implement IT and digital solutions for the organization’s key operational areas, including Self-Help Groups (SHG), Farmer Producer Organizations (FPO), and other livelihood initiatives.
* Build and manage IT-enabled tracking mechanisms for critical program activities such as access to finance, fodder security, farmer field schools etc.
* Guide and support teams in data collection, digital reporting, and IT system optimization to enhance program efficiency.
* Work closely with global teams to customize and improve IT tools, cloud services, and collaboration platforms.
* Support the design and implementation of AI-driven mechanisms for predictive analytics, process automation, and enhanced program monitoring.
* Identify opportunities for AI-driven insights, automation, and efficiency improvements across the organization’s digital ecosystem.
* Promote digital-first approaches for monitoring, evaluation, learning, and reporting to improve data-driven decision-making.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and assess their applicability to improve workflow automation and program impact.

Project Effectiveness: Data management, Analysis and Support in Data-based decision-making (25%)
  
  

* Conduct and/or quality ensure all MELS data collected for the project.
* Organize routine data quality assessment on a quarterly basis and performance monitoring of each sub-Award on a semi-annual basis.
* Summarize/aggregate/analyze data at the state/project/FOAB/geography level to promote data- based decision-making and support in the program strategy.
* Manage all data properly in clean form, and analyze to use for project management, learnings, and meet all the reporting needs.
* Work with the project management team to respond to periodic clients and PGPL requests for additional information on project activities and results.
* Building capacity of the project partners, program staff and other stakeholders on MELS and related components (PR, LR, Outcome Monitoring).

Sub Award Design and Management (5%)
  
  

* Collaborate with project holders and PGPL teams in project design and MELS budgeting.
* Support in preparation of sub-award proposals.
* Support research and evaluation initiatives in the country.
* Assist in networking with other development organizations, governments and other line agencies in promoting PGPL development model/initiatives, and potential collaborations.
* Track physical and financial project progress against the annual plan.
* Contribute to the recruitment, training, and supervision of external parties that are contracted to implement special surveys and studies required for evaluating project effects and impacts.

May perform other job-related duties as requested (5%)
  
  
**Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in project planning, Monitoring and Management, Economics and/or Statistics, or Social Science and or an equivalent with an academic focus on monitoring and evaluation or another related field; In addition, person should have good understanding about Information Technology (IT).
* Having a minimum of five (5) years of total experience in I/NGOs, out of which a minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in MELS and research;
* Knowledge and understanding of project Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and Result Framework.
* Knowledge of tool development using the ODK platform; SurveyCTO.
* A good knowledge of Advance Excel, SPSS/STATA; Data visualization tools like PowerBI, Tableau etc.
* Experience in the design and usage of digital data collection tools like Survey-CTO, ODK, key surveys, etc.;
* Sound knowledge and skills in project management, MELS plan, result framework, and evaluation management;
* A good knowledge and skills to manage project database management system.

**Essential Competencies**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate challenging situations to achieve goals and deadlines;
* Demonstrate a high degree of honesty and integrity;
* Motivated to work responsibly with little supervision;
* Ability to meet and deal with others in a courteous and tactful manner;
* Ability to work with sensitive information and to always maintain confidentiality;
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule;
* Fluent in Hindi, English, and Local Language spoken as well as written;
* Have an interest in animals/agriculture community development;
* Willingness and ability to travel locally and internationally;
* Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, PowerPoint, web designing, collaboration platform and tools, and electronic mail software (Microsoft preferred);
* Constant sitting, standing and walking, with occasional bending and lifting; may work at a computer for extended periods of time.

* High level of integrity, professionalism, and meticulous attention to data quality.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse cultures and stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate evidence into program improvements.
* Commitment to continuous learning and innovation in MEL.
