title: Project Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Join a global leader in energy transmission and help shape the future of power.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Project Engineering Manager (SPEM) to lead the engineering execution of large-scale EPC projects from our Noida office. You will oversee a diverse, international team and drive the successful delivery of engineering scopes for high-impact energy infrastructure High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) substation projects valued at 1-2B$+.
  
  
As part of the Product Delivery Group (PDG) and a member of our global Project Engineering Management (PEM) department, you will work alongside experienced project engineering managers across Europe, the US, and Asia. In India, you will report directly to the UK PEM team leader, contributing to a dynamic and diverse community of PEMs.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge HVDC technology, collaborate across global teams, and grow within an organization contributing to the energy transition.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a
**Senior Project Engineering Manager**
, you will lead the successful execution of engineering activities for complex HVDC projects, ensuring alignment with project goals in terms of safety, schedule, cost, quality, and technical requirements.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering activities of the PDG scope of works on large EPC projects, ensuring alignment with schedule, budget, and technical requirements.
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, ensuring that deliverables are integrated, consistent, and aligned with project milestones.
* Act as the technical lead within the project, driving decision-making and managing interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and customers.
* Establish and maintain effective communication with customers, partners, and suppliers on technical topics, ensuring transparency, responsiveness, and trust.
* Anticipate and manage risks by maintaining an up-to-date risk register, driving mitigation plans, and enforcing a structured change management process.
* Ensure high standards of quality and compliance, applying internal processes, safety (EHS) requirements, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
* Represent engineering in project governance, providing clear reporting on progress, issues, and KPIs, and contributing to key project reviews and decisions.
* Support site teams during execution, ensuring a smooth transition from design to construction and commissioning, and resolving technical issues efficiently.
* Mentor and empower project engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the engineering organization.
* Carry our regular and thorough reviews of the progress and delivery of the PDG scope of work assessing all aspects of the project, including time, cost, quality, and risks.

**Desired Characteristics And Experience**

* Engineering degree in Electrical / Power Systems / Electronics / Automation
* 10+ years of experience as Project Engineering Manager or similar role in EPC environments: Energy, Transmission, Distribution, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, or similar industries
* A minimum of 2 projects delivered, managing medium to large size EPC projects. 10M$+ engineering budget managed.
* Strong project management skills and solid experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders, ideally across international and multicultural environments.
* Strong understanding of engineering project lifecycles, risk management, technical interfaces, and configuration/change control.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills: able to influence, align teams, and represent engineering with confidence in internal and customer meetings.
* Fluent in English.
* Comfortable with occasional travel (Europe and internationally) for project needs.

*HVDC experience is a strong asset, but not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates with relevant experience in similar large-scale infrastructure or industrial EPC projects who are eager to learn and contribute to the energy transition.*
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

* Demonstrated delivery of large-scale migrations ($10M+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments with 500+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross-functional teams of 20+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions

* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers

* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers

**Job Title: Manager-Multi Project Coordination -Water & Waste water Mgmt EPC Infra Projects-
**Noida (UP)****

**Water & Waste water Mgmt EPC Infra Projects. Proficiency in project-scheduling software (MS Project), advanced Excel, and ERP / procurement systems is a MUST. Candidates with experience largely in project consulting/PMC are not suitable for this role******

****EPC/Water & Waste Water Management Company****

VP Engineering (HOD)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time (Work from Office)
  
  
**HO Address**
: Techno Towers, Sector 2, Noida-UP (Near DND Flyway, Nearest Metro Station– Sector 15)
  
  
**Notice Period:**
Immediate Joiners or up to 15 Days Maximum
  
  
**Compensation Range –Based On Current Salary And Experience**
Interview – 3 rounds (Virtual or Face to Face)
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* Monday to Saturday
* 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
* Work from Office – Noida Head Office

**Coordinates with:**
Project Managers
  
  

* Project Accountants
* Procurement
* Billing Engineers
* Document Controller
* Clients / PMCs

****Position Overview****
The Project Coordinator is the single execution-side point of accountability for the company's projects, reporting to the Vice President – Engineering. He is the person who, at any moment, can answer for any project: what the current status is, what is stuck, and what needs a decision. His job is not to record status after the fact but to stay ahead of each project — anticipating what it will need next and setting those things in motion before execution is held up.
  
  
The role connects the site project teams, project managers, project accountants, the procurement department, billing engineers, and the document controller, and manages all correspondence with clients and PMCs. He does not hold direct line authority over site teams; he drives accountability through the work program, structured follow-up, and direct escalation to the VP – Engineering. To discharge this responsibility, he is authorised to convene project managers, call for information from any project, and escalate unresolved matters directly to senior management.
  
  
****Roles & Responsibilities****
**Work program & planning**

* Under the supervision of the VP – Engineering, prepare the work program for each project after coordinating with its project manager, and keep it current as the project progresses.
* Read ahead on the work program to identify what each project will need next — materials, work orders, subcontractor mobilization, drawings, approvals — and set those in motion early enough that execution never waits on them.

**Driving execution & removing bottlenecks**

* Ensure work orders and purchase requisitions are raised and issued in time, ahead of when the site needs them, so procurement and mobilization stay ahead of the work front.
* Ensure timely mobilization of resources, subcontractors, and vendors against each project's work program, and check that the manpower and machinery deployed match what the plan requires.
* Coordinate design and drawing approvals, including any third-party vetting, so that pending drawings never hold up work at site.
* Act as the standing point of coordination between project managers, project accountants, and the procurement team — keeping materials, manpower, and inputs aligned to what each project needs.

**Progress monitoring & issue escalation**

* Maintain a separate tracker for each project; monitor actual progress against the work program and flag delays early. Each project is monitored on its own, not rolled up into a single sheet.
* Track each project's key milestones and deliverables, and push the project manager to correct course wherever a site falls behind.
* Actively surface the issues that need management or client attention — decisions pending, approvals stuck, hindrances, resource shortfalls, client defaults — and drive them to resolution rather than merely logging them.

**Client correspondence & contract administration**

* Own all correspondence with clients and PMCs — letters, submissions, replies, and formal notices — working with the document controller on dispatch and record-keeping.
* Issue and log hindrance notifications, and build the supporting record for time-extension (EOT) claims so the company's contractual position is protected.
* Track client instructions and decisions, and maintain a register of all variations / change orders per project with their approval status.

**Billing coordination**

* Track RA bill preparation and submission for each project, and follow up with the client on certification and payment so progress on site converts into money received.
* Coordinate subcontractor billing and payment — the billing engineer prepares the bill and the accounts officer passes it for payment — so that payment delays never stall a subcontractor's work on site.
* Track the status of statutory permissions and NOCs (road-cutting, tree-cutting, railway / utility crossings, environmental clearances) project by project, since these are the most common cause of site delays and the basis for most time-extension claims.

**Reporting & review meetings**

* Prepare a separate progress report for each project — weekly / monthly — for top management, covering progress, key issues, pending decisions, risks, and billing status, so management always has a clean, current read on every project.
* Organize and run the project review meetings chaired by top management; circulate minutes and chase every action item to closure.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering (essential).
* MBA / PGDM in Construction or Project Management is an advantage.
* 8-10 years in EPC / infrastructure project coordination, preferably in water and wastewater work (sewerage networks, sewage treatment plants, pumping stations).
* Hands-on exposure to government-funded programmes such as AMRUT 2.0, Namami Gange, Jal Jeevan Mission, and Smart Cities.
* Working knowledge of government (CPWD / state PWD) and standard EPC contract conditions, RA billing, measurement and reconciliation, BOQ structures, and the mechanics of time-extension, liquidated-damages, and variation claims.
* Proficiency in project-scheduling software (MS Project), advanced Excel, and ERP / procurement systems.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies**

* Ownership and drive — takes personal accountability for keeping every project moving, and pushes matters to closure instead of waiting to be asked.
* Anticipation — reads ahead on the work program and heads off shortfalls in material, manpower, drawings, or approvals before they stall the site.
* Stakeholder management — holds project managers, vendors, and clients accountable through structure and influence rather than direct authority.
* Clear written communication — drafts correspondence, hindrance and time-extension letters, and meeting minutes that are precise and to the point.
* Commercial and contractual awareness — understands how progress, billing, hindrances, and claims connect, and protects the company's position on each.
* Organisation and follow-through — runs many projects in parallel without letting any one slip, and closes out every open action.

****Bias to escalate early**
— surfaces problems and pending decisions to senior management while there is still time to act on**

title: Senior Technical Lead-Generator Excitation Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning.
  
  
Project Engineering:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end project engineering for high-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning.
* Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements.
* Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies.
* Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents.
* Engineer bus work and high-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications.
* Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high-current excitation equipment.
* Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project-specific operating requirements.
* Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable.
* Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements.
* Manage complete project programs for high-current excitation systems, including engineering deliverables, technical risk, schedule alignment, manufacturing readiness, customer reviews, and cross-functional execution.

Field Services:
  
  

* Prepare site execution and commissioning plans in coordination with project managers, engineering teams, customers, and installation contractors.
* Lead site teams during excitation system installation, panel power-up, redundancy checks, I/O verification, loop checks, device checks, and system energization.

**Position Overview**

* As a Project Engineer for FPSO topside design, you will be responsible for managing engineering activities related to the design, procurement, and execution phases of FPSO topside projects. You will ensure that engineering deliverables meet project timelines, specifications, and quality standards while working closely with both internal and external teams.
* Furthermore, the Topside EPM will work in close cooperation with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure that engineering work and deliverables are compliant with all project requirements, classification rules, design codes and industry standards as well as any relevant regulatory aspect.

* Support the Engineering Manager in the coordination and execution of topside design activities.
* Assist in the preparation of project scopes, schedules, and budgets.

* Monitor engineering progress, identify potential risks, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Review and approve technical documentation, drawings, and specifications for the project.
* Provide technical support during construction, fabrication, and installation phases.
* Maintain strong communication with clients, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure project alignment.

* Familiarity with FPSO systems, equipment, and design standards.
* Strong knowledge of project management principles and methodologies.
* Proficiency with engineering design software (e.g., AutoCAD, PDMS, etc.).
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skill

title: Construction - India
description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Engineer / Lead / Manager reporting directly to our Site / Line Manager / Construction to join our team based in India.
  
  
**About us:**
Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality.
  
  
Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last.
  
  
**About The Opportunity We Offer**
*Starting Date: Sep / Oct/Nov / Dec*
**About you:**
We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements:
  
  
**Construction Manager:**

* Oversee site construction activities and contractor performance.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and project requirements.
* Monitor project schedules, budgets, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, and Commissioning teams.
* Manage construction risks, progress reporting, and issue resolution.
* Support commissioning, startup, and project handover.

**Electrical:**

* Manage installation of HV/MV/LV systems, substations, switchgear, transformers, and cabling.
* Supervise contractors and site teams to meet project schedules and quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, project specifications, and industry standards.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA/QC, Procurement, and Commissioning teams.
* Support testing, energization, commissioning, and handover activities.

**Instrumentation**

* Manage installation of instrumentation, control systems, DCS, PLC, ESD, and Fire & Gas systems.
* Coordinate construction activities with Engineering, QA/QC, HSE, and Commissioning teams.
* Supervise contractors and ensure adherence to project specifications and schedules.
* Oversee cable installation, instrument calibration, loop checks, and system testing.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and industry standards.
* Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and project handover activities.

**RCM:**

* Manage multiple construction projects and site teams across the region.
* Ensure compliance with project schedules, budgets, quality, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee EPC contractors and subcontractor performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Commissioning, and Operations teams.
* Monitor project progress, risks, and resource allocation.
* Drive construction best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support project commissioning, handover, and close-out activities.

**Piping:**

* Lead piping construction activities for refinery and oil & gas projects.
* Supervise piping installation, fabrication, erection, testing, and hydrotesting.
* Manage contractors, subcontractors, and site teams.
* Ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, codes, and quality requirements.
* Monitor construction schedules, manpower, productivity, and costs.
* Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and mechanical completion activities.
* Enforce HSE policies and ensure a safe work environment.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA/QC, Planning, and Operations teams.

**Structural Lead:**
Lead structural construction activities for Oil & Gas, refinery, and petrochemical projects, ensuring safe, quality, and timely execution of structural steel, equipment foundations, and civil-structural works.
  
  

* Supervise structural steel fabrication and erection activities.
* Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Coordinate with Civil, Mechanical, Piping, and Construction teams.
* Monitor contractor performance, construction progress, and quality standards.
* Support site inspections, risk assessments, and project handover activities.

**Civil Lead**
:
  
  
Lead and supervise civil construction activities for Oil & Gas, refinery, petrochemical, and industrial projects, ensuring safe, quality, and timely execution of civil works.
  
  

* Manage civil works including foundations, buildings, roads, drainage, and underground utilities.
* Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Coordinate with Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, and Construction teams.
* Monitor contractor performance, construction progress, and quality standards.
* Support inspections, site planning, and project handover activities.

**Material Manager:**
Manage material planning, procurement coordination, inventory control, storage, and distribution for Oil & Gas construction projects to ensure timely availability of materials and efficient project execution.
  
  

* Oversee material receipt, storage, inventory, and issuance at project sites.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Construction, and Logistics teams.
* Monitor material availability to support project schedules.
* Manage warehouse operations and material tracking systems.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and HSE requirements.

**Planning**
The Planning Engineer is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for Oil & Gas construction projects. The role involves coordinating with engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure project milestones are achieved on time and within budget.
  
  

* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules using Primavera P6/MS Project.
* Monitor project progress and identify schedule risks, delays, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to track deliverables.
* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, dashboards, and look-ahead plans.
* Perform schedule analysis, critical path reviews, and resource planning.
* Support project controls, cost tracking, and change management activities.
* Ensure compliance with project timelines and contractual requirements.

**Your career with us:**
Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development
  
  
**What’s next?**
Once receiving your application, our Talent Acquisition professionals will screen and match your profile against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.
  
  
We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube for company updates.

While global strategy ownership remains with the Cluster Delivery Head of Program & Project Services – IN/PH/MY, decision authority of the Program & Project Management Services Manager is focused on operational execution, prioritization, and delivery governance within a single location.

* Given the role has single-location accountability within one Global Delivery Center and country, execute and operationalize the globally defined sub-capability strategy and standards for the managed area / service and team within Program & Project Management Services of P&PS, aligned with the HIT&DWP Service Line strategy.

* Establish and oversee management reporting, review, and change-control processes.

* Manage delivery within agreed budgets and financial frameworks defined at sub-capability level, ensuring cost discipline and forecast accuracy.

* Continuously monitor and analyse market trends affecting the managed area / service and team of GDC to identify opportunities and challenges.

title: Application Engineer for STATCOM
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are hiring a FACTS Application Engineer (STATCOM/SVC) to lead technical proposal and engineering coordination activities for international FACTS projects during the tendering phase through handover to execution.
  
  
The role requires strong technical and project engineering experience, cross-functional coordination skills, and the ability to manage multidisciplinary stakeholders, customers, and subcontractors in a global environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an electrical/power engineering professional to contribute to advanced grid solutions within GE Vernova’s FACTS business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary/Purpose:**
Are you a professional with technical background - and eager to work in a role where you can make a big difference with your contribution? Join us now, as an Application Engineering Manager (AE) for FACTS project.
  
  
Within GE Vernova and Grid Solutions, the FACTS Solution Line (SL) is fully accountable for costing (ITO : Inquiry-To-Order) and providing (OTR : Order-To-Remittance) integrated FACTS solutions worldwide. As such, it owns its tendering force, operations, R&D and product management. It benefits from a complete portfolio of solutions/products to propose electrical reactive power compensations options to Grid Operators, TSOs, Developers…

title: Project Lead (Search and Match)
description:

title: Associate Technical Director - Civil (UK Water)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 We are actively seeking an Associate Technical Director \- Civil to join our Water Civils team. You will be based in our Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Mumbai/ Noida offices. In this role, you'll play a pivotal role in establishing and consolidating relationships across Arcadis and our client base, managing the technical delivery and design outputs of some of the UK's most complex and stimulating projects in the Water sector.
   

  

 The world is witnessing the impact of climate change, rapid urbanization, loss of biodiversity and more frequent floods and wildfires. The role would sit within our Resilience Global Business Area, where we work to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
 Our Water Design and Engineering team is involved in some of the UK’s most complex and stimulating projects that are diverse and technically demanding. We have an excellent reputation in the delivery of such schemes and are working closely with some of the UK’s most established and recognizable companies, undertaking a vast array of projects to enhance the UK’s water infrastructure and environment.
   

  

 As an Associate Technical Director \- Civil, you will be a key leader within our multidisciplinary delivery teams working on a variety of water and wastewater capital projects, having the opportunity to apply your expertise to projects for our clients regionally and across the UK.
   

  

 Reporting to the Technical Director, you will be responsible for technically leading and/or managing the delivery of project\-related tasks to meet budget, timeframe and quality targets, meeting, or exceeding client expectations, promoting and marketing all facets of Arcadis' services during interfaces with clients and other sectors and disciplines, contributing towards the achievement of the divisional business plan and building networks within the industry.
   

  

 To be considered for a role we are seeking candidates with the following credentials:
   

  

* Lead a team (multidisciplinary/ multiple service lines) being responsible for the teams’ performance, people, culture, innovation and growth.
* Provide multi\-disciplinary leadership for the key account/framework of Arcadis UK water business, establishing and consolidating relationships across Arcadis and our client base, taking ownership for the delivery and associated quality.
* Ensure effective project/program management and financial controls for key account/framework. Develop a strong working relationship with key stakeholders/ clients, establish effective channel of communications and actively influence the growth of your team.
* Actively mentor, coach and develop the wider technical team members.
* Ensure seamless delivery, implementation of Project Management responsibilities and Quality processes.
* Assist the UK with pursuits/ tenders.
* Ensure management and financial controls.
* Act as a technical expert for complex projects/ provide technical guidance to team.
* Drive implementation of the latest developments in relevant design and modelling software.
* Manage resourcing, plan workforce, and proactively identify future recruitment needs.
* Possess strong line management skills to lead, grow and upskill the team.
* Understand and lead the promotion of the HS\&W culture of the business within your discipline.
* Provide guidance to the team members to meet the changing technical needs toward innovation and growth, adoption of future trends and technologies, driving standardization and automation.
* Demonstrate appropriate professional standards, recognizing obligations to society, the profession and the environment and exercise responsibilities in an ethical manner. Ensure effective task delegation within your team.
* Manage training plans considering immediate and long\-term business needs.
* Guide regional team/ clients through the technical decision\-making process and provide alternative solutions as required.
* Engaging in global activities and lead team members for the same.
* Working in collaboration with other design disciplines to ensure the integrity of the overall design.
* Roles at this level provide inspiring leadership to our people and support them to realize their potential
* Compliance of Arcadis business management system.


**Required Competencies:**
 Sound work experience in Design \& Engineering, Design \& Build projects in the UK water sector for the following, but not limited to,
   

  

* Non\-Linear assets (e.g., Treatment Plants, Combined sewer overflows \& Pumping Stations)
* Experience in Linear Assets/ Utilities – clean and waste
* Nature Based Solutions and SUDS will be an added advantage.
* Producing and reviewing hydraulic calculations, specifications, drawings and reports
* Working Knowledge of HADES software will be added advantage
* Ability to review buildability of proposed solutions independently and challenge designs.
* Familiar with British and other international standards and practices.
* Demonstrate ability to lead complex projects.
* Health \& Safety Management, awareness to CDM regulations.
* As an experienced professional you will be professionally qualified or, actively working towards it.
* Awareness and applications of Civil 3D, Revit, BIM and Information management.
* A strong, self\-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels and across regions.
* Flexible to adopt new work /challenging work as per business requirement.
* Awareness of Sustainability best practices.
* Good communication skills.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Around 15\+ years of experience and having a BSc/BEng or MSc/MEng or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
* Chartered Engineer status and membership of a professional institution such as ICE, or CIWEM
* Significant experience and track record in technical delivery of process plant systems on complex engineering projects, preferably related to water and wastewater industry.
* Experience of working on design and construct projects using digital design platforms
* Feasibility to Construction design stage delivery experience


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging
   

  

 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
   

  

 \#Join Arcadis.
   

  

 \#Create a Legacy.
   

  

 \#Hybrid
   

  

 \#GECResWaterUK

description:
**iFOREST** 
 is inviting applications from experienced and dynamic professionals for the position of
 
 Programme Lead, Urban Resilience. The ideal candidate must have leadership qualities and a passion for developing sustainable, climate\-resilient, and vibrant urban areas.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Noida (onsite)
 



  





**Required Experience:** 
 Minimum 10 years
 



  





**About iFOREST \& Urban Resilience Programme** 




  





 iFOREST is an environmental research and innovation organisation that seeks to identify, promote, and scale\-up solutions for some of the most pressing environment–development challenges, and to make environmental protection a peoples’ movement by informing and engaging the citizenry on important issues and Programmes. Our core areas of operations include –Climate Change, Just Transition, Green Energy, Urban Resilience, Waste and Pollution, Natural Resource Management, and Environmental and Climate Governance.
 



 The Urban Resilience Programme focuses on building ‘Climate Resilient Cities’, with a comprehensive outlook of shaping the future of our urban areas that are thriving, green, and sustainable. Specific areas of work will include developing heat and cooling action plans, urban design to enhance climate resilience, promoting green cooling technologies, and supporting policy and project implementation.
 



  





**About the role** 




 The successful candidate would be responsible for leading and delivering various outputs of the Urban Resilience Programme, including research, policy, and public engagement, that are impactful and can help to achieve outcomes.
 



 The comprehensive set of tasks required for leading and executing impactful research and engagement work in this context would broadly entail:
 


* Lead and manage various research projects.
* Lead and conduct (as required) in\-depth primary and secondary research, that includes quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Write analytical reports, policy papers, articles, and other forms of communication materials suitable for policy and public engagement.
* Engage with a diverse group of stakeholders (government, businesses, investors, philanthropics, NGOs, media etc.) for conducting and disseminating research.
* Engage with high\-level stakeholders on research and policy deliberations.
* Manage and organise physical and virtual workshops/seminars/meetings as per requirement.
* Develop and manage project budgets, timelines, and performance metrics to track the effectiveness and impact of the program.
* Build the institutional profile, and contribute to the design and development of programmes, including support in the writing of new proposals.
* Any other related assignments as may be entrusted by the reporting authority.



  





**Required Qualification \& Experience** 



* Candidates must have a Master’s in Urban Planning, Urban Design, Urban Management, or equivalent disciplines, with a B. Tech. or B.Arch.
* Minimum 12 years of full\-time experience in urban planning, urban design, heat action plans, cooling technologies etc.
* Experience of working in a think\-tank space would be an added advantage.



  





**Skills/Competencies** 




 The successful candidate should have the following competencies:
 


* Experience in qualitative and quantitative research and delivery of outputs.
* Excellent quantitative and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication skills to engage with key stakeholders
* Ability to comprehend and work on interdisciplinary matters.
* Guide team members on the delivery of outputs towards programmatic goals.
* Day\-to\-day management of team work.
* Ability to build network and engage with a diverse group of people on research and policy issues on multiple platforms.
* Ability to manage time and priorities; work independently under tight deadlines and guide teams.
* Confident, collegial, and passionate person, with an appreciation of the role of think\-tanks in shaping public policies and programmes.



  





*Successful candidate(s) should be open to travel as per the requirement.* 




  





**What we offer** 




 We assure you a rewarding experience if you are passionate to build a career. At iFOREST we strongly support our colleagues’ professional development and recognition, and offer an inclusive and amicable work environment. We offer highly competitive salaries in a think\-tank space, and reward performance through our annual appraisals.
 



  





**Remuneration** 




 Competitive salary as per candidate’s qualification, experience, and competency as required for the position.
 



  





**Application deadline and instructions** 




 Interested candidates may apply by clicking the application link here:
 
 https://forms.gle/3Fz6XZY3s1fFUwrh7

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis\+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
   

  

 As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
   

  

 Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
   

  

 Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
   

  

**Technical Implementation Manager**
 The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis\+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi\-tier deployments of the Head\-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis\+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head\-end software to field network endpoints.
   

  

 Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis\+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go\-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands\-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer\-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical deployment of Landis\+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go\-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head\-End System (HES) across its multi\-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET\-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production\-ready at go\-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis\+Gyr head\-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment\-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis\+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.


**Key Competencies**
* Automation\-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version\-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go\-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self\-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (\~50%)


**Technical Skills**
**Required:**
* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP\-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework


**Preferred:**
* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two\-way AMI technology, from head\-end software to field endpoints


**Qualifications – Education And Experience**
* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10\+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud\-based or technical deployment roles
* Experience deploying multi\-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments

 Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. **About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited** 




***Jubilant Ingrevia is now a member of the elite Global Lighthouse Network (GLN) of the World Economic Forum (WEF)***




  





***Celebrating our Culture and People.***




***We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified!***




 Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.
 



 Ingrevia is born out of a union of ‘Ingredients’ and ‘Life’ (‘Vie’ in French). Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is committed to offering high\-quality and innovative life science ingredients to enrich all forms of life.
 



 Jubilant Ingrevia, a global integrated Life Science products and Innovative Solutions provider serving, Pharmaceutical, Nutrition, Agrochemical, Consumer and Industrial customers with our customised products and solutions that are innovative, cost\-effective and conforming to excellent quality standards.
 



 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited offers a broad portfolio of high\-quality ingredients that find application in a wide range of industries. Jubilant Ingrevia’s portfolio also extends to custom development and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and agrochemical customers on an exclusive basis.
 



 Our business is split across 3 business verticals, with global leadership across our key product lines.
 



  





***Speciality Chemicals:***
 The Specialty Chemical business of Jubilant Ingrevia manufactures Pyridine, Picolines and its forward integration derivatives, which finds application in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes, solvents, metal finishes, fine chemicals, semiconductors etc.
 



 We have also launched new platform of Diketene \& its value\-added derivatives for multiple industry use. We are an established ‘partner of choice’ in CDMO, with more investment plans in GMP \& Non\-GMP multi\-product facilities for Pharma, Agro and Semi\-conductor customers.
 



***Chemical Intermediates:***
 The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.
 



***Nutrition \& Health Solutions:***
 The Nutrition \& Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 \& Picolinates (Chromium \& Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high\-quality feed \& food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua \& pet food industry. In Human Nutrition \& Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients \& premix solutions to nutrition.
 



 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in India. We practice world\-class manufacturing processes in our day\-to\-day operations, assuring our customers with unmatched quality and timely delivery of products through innovations and cutting\-edge technology. Transforming Manufacturing for Operational Excellence \& Sustainability with “zero tolerance to any non\-compliance” is the core focus of Jubilant Ingrevia Manufacturing.
 



 We have 5 world\-class manufacturing facilities i.e. One in UP at Gajraula, Two in Gujarat at Bharuch and Savli, Two in Maharashtra at Nira and Ambernath.
 



***Environment Sustainability***




 The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.
 



 Find out more about us at www.jubilantingrevia.com
 



  





**The Position**




  





**Organization : \-** 
 Jubilant Ingrevia Limited
 



**Designation \& Level: \-**

 Greater Noida
 



  





**Job Summary**




  





 The Group Leader \- Pharma CDMO will lead a team of scientists involved in route scouting, process development, scale\-up, technology transfer, and commercialization of pharmaceutical APIs \& intermediates and specialty ingredients for global CDMO customers. title: Engineering Manager
description:
We are a leading technology company building enterprise\-grade platforms for
 **Lending Origination Systems (LOS), Digital Lending, Supply Chain Finance (SCF), Embedded Finance** 
 , and financial institution\-led lending transformation.

 **Engineering Manager**

**The Role** 




 This is
 **not** 
 a traditional people\-management role. We are looking for an engineering leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building high\-performing teams, and delivering enterprise software at scale.
 



 As an Engineering Manager, you will lead one or more product engineering squads responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating mission\-critical platforms. While your primary responsibility is engineering leadership, you are expected to remain technically engaged—reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, debugging complex problems, reviewing code, and contributing production code whenever required.
 



 You will help shape engineering culture, improve developer productivity, drive AI adoption, and ensure predictable, high\-quality software delivery.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Lead High\-Performing Engineering Teams** 



* Build, mentor, and grow high\-performing engineering squads.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Coach engineers and technical leads through regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development.
* Hire exceptional engineering talent and build strong succession planning within the team.
* Create an environment where engineers take end\-to\-end ownership of customer outcomes.



**2\. Drive Technical Excellence** 



* Review architecture, solution designs, and critical engineering decisions.
* Establish high engineering standards through rigorous design and code reviews.
* Contribute production\-quality code or prototypes when required.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex production issues.
* Drive engineering simplicity, maintainability, scalability, and performance.
* Continuously reduce technical debt and improve overall platform health.



**3\. Deliver Predictably** 



* Own engineering delivery for product initiatives, customer implementations, and platform modernization.
* Drive sprint planning, estimation, release planning, and execution discipline.
* Remove delivery bottlenecks and proactively manage risks and dependencies.
* Partner closely with Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Security, Customer Success, and Support teams.
* Ensure every release meets quality, security, and operational readiness expectations.



**4\. Build Engineering Excellence** 



* Improve code quality through peer reviews, coding standards, and test automation.
* Champion automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Use engineering metrics (DORA metrics, defect leakage, etc.) to continuously improve productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for production incidents and ensure permanent corrective actions.
* Build systems that are secure, resilient, observable, and easy to operate.



**5\. Lead AI\-Enabled Engineering** 



* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software development across the engineering organization.
* Encourage responsible use of AI for coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and code reviews.
* Establish engineering guardrails and security standards for AI\-generated code.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools that improve engineering productivity while maintaining quality and security.



**6\. Partner Across the Business** 



* Communicate engineering progress, risks, trade\-offs, and delivery status clearly to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Product, Delivery, Business, Architecture, Security, and Executive Leadership.
* Represent Engineering during customer discussions, executive reviews, and technical escalations.
* Translate complex technical decisions into clear business outcomes.



**What We’re Looking For** 




**Experience \& Background** 



* **10\+ years** 
 of total software engineering experience, with
 **at least 2 years** 
 in an Engineering Manager or Technical Leadership role.
* Strong software engineering background prior to moving into engineering management.
* Proven experience building enterprise SaaS, fintech, banking, or large\-scale B2B platforms.
* Experience leading cross\-functional engineering teams across backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps.
* Demonstrated track record delivering cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices\-based applications.
* Experience working with regulated enterprise customers such as banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, or insurance companies.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, release management, DevSecOps, engineering governance, and production operations.
* *Desirable:* 
 Prior domain experience with Lending Origination Systems (LOS), Digital Lending, Supply Chain Finance (SCF), or Financial Services platforms.



**Technical Competencies** 




**Core Stack** 



* **Backend:** 
 Java (Java 17/21 preferred), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, REST APIs, Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, Distributed Systems, SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) \& NoSQL/Caching (Redis) Databases.

 Angular (preferred), TypeScript, Modern JavaScript Frameworks, Responsive Web Applications.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** 
 AWS (preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions / Jenkins, CI/CD Pipelines, Infrastructure Automation.



**Engineering Practices** 



* API\-First Architecture and Specification\-Driven Development (OpenAPI).

* AI\-Assisted Software Development and Productivity Engineering.

description:
TÜV SÜD Group – A global leader in the field of testing, inspection, management system certification and product certification renowned for quality, integrity and technical excellence.
   

  

 Established more than 150 years ago in Germany, TÜV SÜD Group is a leading global provider of technical services with more than 30,000 highly skilled employees across 1,000 offices worldwide. TÜV SÜD Group offers a wide range of testing \& product certification, inspection, auditing \& system certification, training and knowledge services. We are a premium quality, safety, and sustainability solutions provider.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To supervise and coordinate the mechanical workforce during the execution of
 **Mechanical Pre\-Commissioning and Commissioning activities** 
 , ensuring that all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved project procedures, technical specifications, drawings, and project schedules.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for coordinating with Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Operations, and contractor teams to ensure smooth system completion, testing, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Supervise mechanical workforce during execution of pre\-commissioning activities, including:
+ Vessel cleaning and internal inspection
+ Internal checks and final box\-up
+ Card blasting and sheet blasting
+ Steam blowing
+ Air blowing
+ Equipment inspection and preparation
+ Other mechanical system pre\-commissioning activities

* Ensure mechanical pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities are properly planned, organized, scheduled, executed, and documented in a safe and structured manner.
* Read and interpret OEM manuals, engineering drawings, P\&IDs, technical specifications, procedures, and other project documentation.
* Perform troubleshooting and provide technical support during pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities.
* Demonstrate good knowledge of the working principles, operation, maintenance, installation, and commissioning requirements of rotating and static equipment.
* Identify and minimize installation and operational errors during mechanical installation, pre\-commissioning, and commissioning activities.
* Coordinate with Electrical and Instrumentation teams during commissioning activities, including:
+ Motor solo runs
+ Process line\-up
+ Load trials
+ Equipment functional checks
+ Interdisciplinary commissioning activities

* Coordinate effectively with contractors and other project teams to ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
* Read, interpret, and review technical drawings, P\&IDs, specifications, procedures, and engineering documentation.
* Support system and subsystem scoping for process systems.
* Develop, review, and implement Pre\-Commissioning and Commissioning procedures.
* Review and update P\&ID redline mark\-ups based on site conditions and commissioning requirements.
* Identify system\-specific risks and ensure appropriate risk management and mitigation measures are implemented before and during commissioning activities.
* Provide inputs to the Completions Management System (CAMS), including review and approval of project\-specific Inspection \& Test Records (ITRs) / check sheets.
* Monitor progress against approved project plans and schedules and provide inputs to ensure achievement of agreed milestones.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve technical and execution issues affecting project schedules.
* Ensure all mechanical pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities comply with HSE requirements, approved procedures, quality standards, and project specifications.
* Support system completion, testing, certification, and handover activities to Operations.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Mechanical Pre\-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in Oil \& Gas / Petrochemical / Refinery / Energy projects.
* Knowledge of static and rotating equipment and their installation, operation, maintenance, and commissioning requirements.
* Good understanding of P\&IDs, mechanical drawings, OEM manuals, technical specifications, and commissioning procedures.
* Knowledge of system/subsystem scoping and system completion processes.
* Experience in P\&ID redline mark\-ups.
* Understanding of ITRs, check sheets, punch\-list management, and completion documentation.
* Knowledge of CAMS or similar Completions Management Systems.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of project HSE requirements and risk assessment/mitigation.
* Good computer skills and ability to work with project documentation and reporting systems.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in Mechanical Pre\-Commissioning and Commissioning within Oil \& Gas, Petrochemical, Refinery, Power, or similar process industries.
* Experience in supervising mechanical contractors and workforce at project sites.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary project environments.

title: PMO Analyst, LAB49 Noida
description:

Founded in 2002, Lab49 combines strategy, design, and technology expertise to deliver transformative outcomes for investment banks, asset managers, exchanges, and other capital markets participants.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Lab49 is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented PMO Analyst to support the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives. The PMO Analyst will play a key role in driving project governance, integrated planning, reporting, risk management, resource coordination, and delivery controls across complex programs.
   

  

 This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical skills, and the ability to provide transparency into project performance, dependencies, risks, and milestones while supporting delivery teams and leadership.
   

  

 “
 **Success in this role means building a PMO that improves delivery outcomes, not simply administering governance activities”**
**Key Responsibilities**
**PMO Capability Building and Operating Model**
* Help design, establish, and mature a scalable PMO operating model covering governance, integrated planning, reporting, financial controls, resource management, risk management, and delivery assurance.
* Establish common delivery metrics and dashboards that give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, quality, and financial performance.
* Create reusable playbooks for discovery, mobilization, execution, release readiness, stabilization, and program closure.


**End\-to\-End Delivery Management**
* Support delivery from initial discovery and mobilization through planning, execution, release, stabilization, and closure.
* Maintain an end\-to\-end view across business, product, design, architecture, engineering, quality engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations.
* Identify sequencing issues, delivery gaps, conflicting priorities, and cross\-team dependencies before they affect critical milestones.
* Drive ownership of actions and decisions, ensuring unresolved items are escalated with clear impact assessments and recommended options.
* Conduct delivery health checks, provide an independent evidence\-based view of status, and support recovery planning for at\-risk workstreams.
* Coordinate distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, functions, and partner organizations.


**AI\-Enabled Delivery and PMO**
* Use approved AI capabilities to improve the speed and quality of planning, reporting, meeting synthesis, dependency analysis, knowledge retrieval, and management communications.
* Ensure AI use complies with firm’s confidentiality, data\-protection, information\-security, and responsible\-use requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PMO activities such as status consolidation, action tracking, document classification, and governance\-pack preparation.


**Governance and Executive Communication**
* Prepare concise executive updates that clearly distinguish progress, risks, decisions required, implications, and recommended actions.
* Maintain accurate records of decisions, commitments, actions, and escalations.
* Prepare and maintain governance materials, status reports, steering committee packs, and executive dashboards.
* Monitor project progress against agreed milestones and provide delivery traceability and reporting.


**Integrated Planning, Risks, and Dependencies**
* Own or coordinate integrated planning across multiple workstreams and delivery organizations.
* Establish dependency\-management practices that identify upstream and downstream impacts across product, technology, operations, and third parties.
* Facilitate RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management and ensure timely escalation of delivery risks and blockers.


**Financial, Commercial, and Resource Management**
* Support program budgeting, forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis.
* Maintain visibility into team capacity, onboarding, allocation, role requirements, and forward demand.
* Connect resource plans with delivery milestones, critical skills, and workstream priorities.
* Support commercial tracking across statements of work, deliverables, milestones, change requests, and client commitments.
* Identify potential scope, timeline, or cost impacts early and support structured change\-control discussions.
* Provide forward\-looking views of capacity gaps and delivery constraints rather than relying only on retrospective reporting.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7 years of experience in PMO, project governance, delivery management, program controls, or related technology\-delivery roles.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning PMO workstreams and building or improving delivery\-governance practices within complex technology programs.
* Experience with RAID management, integrated planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders in a fast\-paced consulting environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting technology delivery programs within financial services, capital markets, banking, or fintech organizations.
* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience with financial tracking, resource planning, and executive reporting.

**What You'll Bring**
* Strong attention to detail and execution excellence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
Job\_role: Logistics Specialist
 



 Job\-Location: Noida/Delhi\-NCR
 



 Experience required: 8\+ years
 



  





 Job Description:
 



 This role is responsible for the implementation and execution of the company's truck transportation strategy, ensuring reliable and cost\-effective movement of goods. The Logistics Specialist will oversee the execution of truck logistics and fleet management in close coordination with various internal departments. This position will manage the truck freight profit and loss (P\&L), which includes forecasting freight costs and managing execution against these forecasts. It also interacts and actively contributes to other corporate functions, driving efficiency and continuous improvement across the supply chain.
 



  





**What You'll Be Doing:**




 • Schedule and execute truck movements, actively seeking opportunities to optimize routes, maximize backhauls, and enhance overall network efficiency in conjunction with supply chain, sales, and operations teams.
 



 • Establish clear and robust Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure progress on transportation optimization, service levels, and cost efficiency.
 



 • Negotiate and manage transportation relationships with carriers, including building strategic partnerships and identifying and onboarding new service providers to expand capabilities and enhance competitiveness.
 



 • Utilize and further develop analytical tools and data models to improve freight spend analysis, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and enhance decision\-making.
 



 • Strengthen partnerships with internal operations, warehousing, and customer service teams, and serve as a key point of contact with carriers, suppliers, and customers to ensure positive and seamless logistical experiences at all touchpoints.
 



 • Oversee the price risk management of truck freight, ensuring the right balance between capacity availability, service reliability, and spend optimization.
 



 • Approve freight invoices, conduct thorough freight variance analysis, and develop actionable plans to implement improvements and address discrepancies.
 



 • Lead the development and implementation of standardized processes in both freight management and execution across the organization to ensure consistency and efficiency.
 



 • Lead and participate in transportation technology initiative by managing integration and daily execution at the local level.
 



  





**Skills/Experience Requirements:** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



 • 8\+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, or supply chain roles, with a significant focus on truck freight management.
 



 • Experience in carrier relationship management, contract negotiation, and procurement of transportation services.
 



 • Familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
 



 • Experience with data analysis and reporting to drive logistics performance.
 



 • Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with a proven ability to secure favorable terms with carriers and other service providers.
 



 • Proactive and innovative approach to identifying and resolving logistical challenges.
 



 • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners (carriers, suppliers, customers).
 



 • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.

title: Process Engineering Lead
description:
**About CRA** 
  





 CRA designs and manufactures custom\-engineered systems for the Energy and Defence sectors. We deliver complex projects end\-to\-end, entirely in\-house, combining design, engineering, and manufacturing under one roof. Our systems are trusted by leading organisations including BrahMos Aerospace, ONGC, Indian Air Force, and Schlumberger.
   





**Role Overview** 
  





 You will own process design across CRA’s product lines: flares, thermal oxidisers, H2S scrubbers, biogas cleaning and upgrading, and gas compression systems. You will take designs from sizing through to commissioning, and lead and develop the process engineering team.
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  




* Originate the design basis, heat and mass balance, PFD and P\&IDs for each project
* Size equipment, lines and relief devices, and prepare process datasheets for equipment and instruments
* Carry out combustion, flare sizing and thermal radiation calculations
* Write control philosophies and cause and effect matrices, working with the E\&I team
* Represent CRA in client HAZOP, SIL and design reviews, and close out actions
* Support the applications team on sizing, performance guarantees and technical clarifications
* Check mechanical and E\&I deliverables against the process design before release
* Support FAT, commissioning and performance tests, and troubleshoot on site
* Develop calculation templates and standard P\&IDs for repeat products.


 Requirements
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering; Mechanical engineers with a strong combustion background will be considered
* 10\+ years in process design with an equipment manufacturer, package vendor or EPC, including P\&IDs and heat and mass balances you originated
* Design experience in at least one of: flares, thermal oxidisers or incinerators, burners, biogas treatment and upgrading, gas compression and conditioning
* Working knowledge of API 521, API 537 and ISA 5\.1, and of burner management requirements (NFPA 86, EN 746\-2 or equivalent)
* HAZOP experience as the design owner
* Strong hand calculations; HYSYS or similar simulation an advantage
* Willing to travel for FAT and site work.



*This role requires hands\-on design origination. Experience limited to relief valve sizing, simulation support or plant operations will not be sufficient.* 
  

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical insurance
* Learning and development support
* Clear career growth pathways
* Opportunity to work on critical projects in energy and defence.

title: Senior Engineer - Solar
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP has a long history in the delivery of high\-quality technical advisory and management consultancy services focused on renewable energy. We have worked on ground mount, floating and rooftop solar developments, including some of the world’s largest solar PV projects. We have established client relationships with some of the largest and most well\-known developers, investors and lenders in the industry and we support their projects across the globe. Delivering high quality, proactive, prompt and up to date technical services to our clients is paramount. We offer services at all stages of the project lifecycle, with a particular focus on the following core services:
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Energy yield and resource assessments, Conducting Independent EYA
* Site layouts and optimisation, concept design and feasibility studies
* Technical due diligence for lenders on IPP transactions.
* Technical Advisor, Lender’s Technical Advisor (LTA) scopes of work,
* Preparing conceptual design of the utility scale solar plants.
* Preparing RFP, MFS and tender bid packages.
* Project development and Owner’s Engineer (OE) scopes of work, including tendering and contracting support, construction monitoring and management, and technical advisory services.
* Ability to handle global clients smoothly and collaboratively work with the cross regional teams.
* WSP has ambitions to significantly expand our renewable energy team. We have a range of roles available to suit people at all points of their career and development. We are seeking talented engineers or renewable energy professionals with experience in the delivery of any of WSP’s core scopes for solar PV development.
* Applications are encouraged from those who have rich experience in Solar PV field as an EPC contractor, developer, or OEMs, in addition to those with consultancy experience. WSP’s aim is to build a team with broad range of experience to allow us to allow the best value and advice to our clients.


 This role will report to the Head of Renewables and will require working closely with the other renewable energy sector teams, technical discipline leads, and WSP’s ME offices. In addition to providing technical expertise, a key element of this role is to contribute to the development of a close\-knit high\-performing specialist team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* A degree in a relevant engineering, ideally with a graduate qualification related to electrical engineering and/or renewable energy with experience of 10 to 15 years.
* Experience in the delivery of solar PV projects, ideally within the ME and internationally on utility scale projects, and at least one of WSP’s core services.
* Knowledge of solar PV technology (incl. different types of Modules, Tracker, MMS etc.) and the project development process.
* Conducting Energy Yield Assessment, Simulations for Configuration Optimization, Near and Far Shading Analysis etc.
* Exact estimation of losses, uncertainties etc. to be considered in the modelling.
* Equipment Sizing and Technology Selection.
* Site suitability assessment for large scale solar PV plants.
* Cost optimization and capitalization for engineering for both AC \& DC BOS.
* Preparing Technical specification of DC system.
* Sound in design knowledge in areas of solar plant layouts, tray Layout, cable routing layouts, ICR Blocks layouts and Switchyard layouts of large\-scale solar power plants
* Review \& approval of design calculation, drawings, etc.
* Expert on areas like transformers, Inverters, Transmission, and other major electrical components.
* Engineering monitoring and control, in relation to Project Setup.
* Pre bid Engineering, Tendering, basic and design Engineering.
* Experience in managing large scale utility projects, developing client relationships, and working in a consultancy environment.
* OPTIONAL\- Some experience in business development and/or winning work.


 Software skills –
   

  

* PVSyst, PV Case, AutoCad, Helioscope, Google Sketchup etc.

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:

**www.wsp.com**
